summary: DoubleVerify Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K/A amending its prior 8-K to correct a press release announcing a definitive Agreement and Plan of Merger with Neptune BidCo US Inc. (Parent) and its wholly owned subsidiary Wallace Merger Sub Inc. Under the agreement, Merger Sub will merge into DoubleVerify, with the company surviving as a wholly owned subsidiary of Parent, effectively taking it private. The filing includes the corrected press release as Exhibit 99.1 and notes that a proxy statement will be filed for a special stockholders' meeting to approve the transaction. No financial terms, premium, or advisors were disclosed in this excerpt. Watch for the forthcoming proxy statement detailing deal terms, vote timing, and any go-shop or termination provisions.
